text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I can do this... if I just maintain this 
speed! Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe! This kind of speed in the final 
stretch... But still!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Top speed! I will surpass myself! 
HYAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line in the lead! 
Taking the victory in the Sprinters Stakes 
is—

Calstone Light O crossed the finish line 
lagging behind the leader... but.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOHHH!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Right O, where are you going!? 
You've already crossed the finish line!

Calstone Light O rounded the corner just 
like that, and kept running for a while...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... wheeze... haa...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: W-Welcome back... Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I... I thought I could reach it, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Will it reach...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was... so close. Just a little more... 
and I would've made it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Into... that light............ *hack* 
*cough*, *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Are you all right? Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, there's no need... *cough* to 
worry! I'll take my time alone, *hack*! 
*wheeze*!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I will go with you. Is it alright if I 
touch your back?"

Back in the waiting room, I asked Calstone 
Light O why she had kept running even 
after crossing the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Because it felt like I could almost reach 
the light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight... after feeling 
Believe, it felt like I was running while 
floating in midair."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Though her legs must have felt heavy, her 
turnover didn't stop, and she kept 
running. As if someone were pushing her 
from behind.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And up ahead... I saw a light. It felt 
like if I just kept running, I could reach 
it. All the way to the other side of that 
light...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, when my speed dropped, the 
light moved farther away as well.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it just like during the Ibis Summer 
Dash? From the unique excitement of a 
race, she was able to unleash power beyond 
her usual..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Official races possess a mysterious 
power. That is particularly prominent in 
GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Did Bakushin O have a similar experience?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I certainly do! The cheers from all my 
fans and running alongside my rivals gave 
me strength!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To me in particular, having rivals made a 
massive difference!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I challenged her wanting to win, but at 
her preferred distance, I was turned away 
time and again. Though I refused to yield, 
just as she did.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat Flight-san— that desire 
became my greatest fuel. And fueled by 
that flame, I kept running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is a strength that can only be 
unlocked by clashing fiercely against your 
rival...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...On the flip side, lacking rivals can 
sometimes extinguish one's inner fire, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, the reason I felt Believe's 
presence so strongly today of all days 
was...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Rivals are necessary to reach top speed. 
When Trainer told me that before, I simply 
took it at face value, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Today, however, I truly felt it...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“Competition... Battles against rivals are 
essential to becoming faster!”

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Then for my next race, I want to compete 
against fast opponents! Umamusume who can 
race for top speed with me, just like 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to run in another GⅠ race 
next time too!
choice_data_list:
Then let's aim to conquer the Spring and 
Autumn Sprint G1s.

text_block_list.text:
The Spring and Autumn Sprint GⅠs—the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen in spring, and the 
Sprinters Stakes in autumn. Currently, 
these are the only two turf sprint GⅠ 
races.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Which means the spring Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you win both the Spring and Autumn 
Sprint GIs next year, you'll truly be the 
fastest Umamusume in both name and deed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us reach the pinnacle of speed in 
the Spring and Autumn Sprint GⅠs!

That night, aboard the Shinkansen on the 
way back.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, what a coincidence. Though the 
timing is actually perfect.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm running in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. 
I want to race against you once more 
there!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: With... me?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Competing against you will make me 
even faster. I might become faster than I 
can even imagine!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go beyond the light I saw 
today. I want to reach the very frontier 
of speed!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can reach it if I'm with 
you. So this is just a selfish request of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, let's run in the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, it is a rather selfish request.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However... just as you aim for maximum 
speed, I will deliver a perfected run on 
the stage that demands the highest level 
of mastery.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"... That's one 
of the spring/autumn sprint GⅠs. You too, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we share the same path. You 
and I will compete once again right there.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: At the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time, I will win. Bringing 
together the pinnacle of technique, I will 
deliver a flawless performance."
